title: sideritis antiatlantica
intro: Sideritis antiatlantica, commonly known as the Atlantic mountain tea, is a perennial plant species within the genus Sideritis. This plant is known for its traditional use in folk medicine, where it is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Sideritis antiatlantica include analgesic, antispasmodic, and anti-cancer activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Sideritis antiatlantica play a crucial role in its therapeutic actions and contribute to its use in the treatment of various health conditions.
